meta.verification_note: Verified means name, grade, and description are corroborated by at least two guides; reported means name and grade are corroborated while unlock details are still being pinned down; unconfirmed means the public description is known but the exact trigger is not confirmed. Leads for unconfirmed trophies are labelled as leads, not facts.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Finish the full trophy set to close out the platinum. Keep the tracker updated as you go, then check that the other 54 entries are marked earned.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the in-game completion breakdown to clear every activity included in the 100% total. The headline collection targets on this page are route markers; verify the final percentage in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Build your stunt count across Leonida and keep an eye on the activity total until it reaches 250. The 100% checklist has a separate 300-jump target, so track both counters independently.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.official_description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the Shooting Range and earn gold in each listed challenge, not just a passing medal. Recheck the range menu after each visit to spot any challenge still below gold.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.official_description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find strangers around the state and follow each available strand through its final mission. Keep a note of completed characters so you reach eight full strands without repeating early encounters.
